meta.producto: A small black mechanical assembly is being assembled.
meta.operacion: The right hand typically holds the workpiece in the center while the left hand fetches tools or parts from the bottom to perform assembly tasks.
meta.lugar: Supply areas: bottom (blue and red bins). Work point: center. Instructions: left side of the table.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the top. The right hand (magenta) appears on the left/center and the left hand (cyan) appears on the center/right of the image.
meta.title_en: Gearbox reassembly with tools (IMPACT dataset, unseen operator)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B on AMD GPUs (AMD Token Factory, shared endpoint)
meta.licencia_en: Video and labels: IMPACT dataset (KratosWen/IMPACT on Hugging Face), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. This example (chart and frames) is shared under the same licence, for non-commercial use.
